summary: This informational RFC describes the namespace identifier mef for URNs naming resources published by the MEF Forum, which specifies and manages these resources.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 7818 registers mef as a namespace identifier for URNs naming resources published by the MEF Forum. MEF manages the names and records them in its MANN registry.

questions: what is the mef urn namespace
subtitle: The MEF Forum's registered namespace identifier for persistent resource names.

tldr.problem: The MEF Forum needed unique, persistent names for resources it publishes and manages.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 7818 describes the URN namespace identifier mef and assigns management of its resource names to MEF through the MANN registry.
tldr.outcome: IANA added mef to the URN Namespaces registry. The RFC says MEF manages assignments and records resources in its MANN registry.

today: RFC 7818 is an Informational document describing the mef URN namespace. It records IANA's addition of that identifier to the URN Namespaces registry.

sections.title: Why MEF Needs a Namespace
sections.content: The MEF Forum is an international industry standards organization focused on Carrier Ethernet networks and services. It publishes specifications in Services, Architecture, and Operations and Management. RFC 7818 describes a managed namespace for uniquely and persistently identifying those resources.
sections.plainLanguage: MEF publishes specifications and other resources. A managed namespace gives those resources names that are unique and persistent.

sections.title: How the mef URN Namespace Is Managed
sections.content: The namespace identifier is mef. MEF manages resource classes that use it and is responsible for uniqueness of the associated strings, or may permit another party to manage defined resources. Assignments are documented in the MEF Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry. The entire URN is case-insensitive.
sections.plainLanguage: MEF manages the names that use the mef identifier. It records assignments in the MANN registry, and uppercase or lowercase letters have the same meaning.

sections.title: Examples and Resolution
sections.content: The RFC gives urn:mef:yang:mef-services and urn:mef:yang:mef-interfaces as examples of names MEF is looking to assign. It states that the namespace is not listed with a Resolution Discovery System, so it does not specify a resolution process.
sections.plainLanguage: The document shows example names for MEF resources. It does not define a way to look up a resource from its URN.
